_comment: Committed English content for the long_policy family (B-13 P2, JB-4). Two shapes: 'routing' (approval bands over a computed contract value) and 'coverage' (policy conditions/exclusions deciding a claim outcome). The generator composes the document text AND the rule facts/trees from these same pieces; targets are executions, never indices. Style mirrors the JevBench hard family without reusing any of its text.

routing.question: Determine the required approval level for request {ref} under policy {clause} as amended.
routing.intro:
{org} — {title} {clause} (version {version}, effective {effective})

EXTRACT FOR APPROVAL ROUTING, WITH PURCHASE REQUEST {ref}
clause_text:
1. Purpose and scope
1.1 This policy governs approvals of all purchase and spend requests raised by {org} and its subsidiaries, excluding payroll, taxes and intercompany charges.
2. Definitions
2.1 "Total Contract Value" or "TCV" means the full multi-year value committed by the request: the annual value times the number of contract years, plus one-time fees, plus any one-off onboarding charges.
2.2 TCV excludes conditional or time-limited promotional discounts that are not stated in the order form.
2.3 "Related Purchases" are requests from the same cost centre submitted within the 90 days before this request; where the combined value crosses a band, the higher level applies (aggregation clause).
3. Approval levels (the highest level reached decides)
{bands}
4. Evidence in the request file
4.1 Request {ref}: {components}. {aggregation_note}
4.2 The order form also quotes {discount_note}

bands.desc: Level 1 is the highest level reached (TCV up to EUR 10,000).
Level 2 is the highest level reached (above EUR 10,000 up to EUR 50,000).
Level 3 is the highest level reached (above EUR 50,000 up to EUR 150,000).
Level 4 is the highest level reached (above EUR 150,000 up to EUR 500,000).
Level 5 is the highest level reached (above EUR 500,000).

component_templates: an annual value of EUR {annual} over {years} contract year(s), a one-time onboarding fee of EUR {fee}, and a one-off documentation charge of EUR {extra}
an annual value of EUR {annual} over {years} contract year(s), a one-time integration fee of EUR {fee}, and a one-off training charge of EUR {extra}
discount_notes: a promotional discount of EUR {discount}, conditional on signing within 14 days.
a conditional rebate of EUR {discount}, payable only if volume targets are met.
a time-limited introductory credit of EUR {discount}, subject to review.
aggregation_notes: Related Purchases approved in the last 90 days total EUR {related} and must be added.
Two Related Purchases from the same cost centre total EUR {related}; the aggregation clause applies.
No Related Purchases fall in the 90-day window.

coverage.question: Acting as the coverage reviewer, decide how the reported loss under claim {ref} must be settled under the policy form above.

clauses.window: A. Notice window. A loss must be reported within {window} days of the date it was discovered. Claims reported later are denied as late notice.
clauses.vacancy: B. Vacancy exclusion. The dwelling is excluded for any loss occurring while it has been unoccupied for more than {vacancy_days} consecutive days before the loss.
clauses.sublimit: C. Water damage. Water damage caused by a leak hidden inside a wall — unknown to the occupant until damage appeared — is covered subject to a sublimit of EUR {sublimit}. Water damage with a visible, accessible cause is covered in full, with no sublimit.
clauses.deductible: D. Deductible. Each approved claim is paid after deducting EUR {deductible} from the settled amount.

causes.text: Cause: water escaping from a pipe inside the wall cavity, hidden from view until the damage appeared.
Cause: a burst feed hose under the sink, visible and accessible from the start.

outcomes.desc: The loss is denied because it was reported after the notice window closed.
The loss is denied under the vacancy exclusion for the stated period of absence.
The loss is covered but payment is capped by the concealed-leak sublimit of EUR {sublimit}.
The loss is covered without any sublimit; the full estimate is paid after deducting EUR {deductible}.
